lead: Dara Singh was an Indian politician, born on 19 November 1928 in Punjab.
He died on 12 July 2012 in Mumbai at the age of 83.
He has 32 credited works on public record and has held the office of member of Rajya Sabha.
The sections that follow break down Dara Singh's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.
